title: Immediate Crisis Support
subtitle: If you're in crisis or need immediate help, you're not alone. These resources are available 24/7.

alert.title: In Immediate Danger?
alert.description: If you or someone you know is in immediate danger, please call emergency services (19) or go to the nearest emergency room right away.

nationalHotline.name: National Listening Line
nationalHotline.description: Free, confidential support for mental health crisis

ngos.title: Mental Health Organizations
ngos.description: Professional mental health support services in Morocco

depression.name: Moroccan Association Against Depression
depression.description: Support groups and resources for people living with depression and their families
depression.contact: Contact via your local health center

hospitals.name: Psychiatric Hospitals
hospitals.description: Major psychiatric care facilities in Morocco

resources.title: What to Do in a Crisis
resources.description: Steps to take when you or someone you know is in a mental health crisis

recognize.title: Recognize the Signs
recognize.description: Intense emotional distress, thoughts of self-harm, disconnection from reality, or feeling unable to cope.

reach.title: Reach Out Immediately
reach.description: Call a crisis hotline, contact a trusted friend or family member, or go to an emergency room.

safe.title: Stay Safe
safe.description: Remove access to means of self-harm. Stay with someone if possible. Focus on immediate safety.

support.title: Get Professional Support
support.description: Follow up with a mental health professional. Crisis is temporary - help is available.

footer.title: You Are Not Alone
footer.message: Thousands of Moroccans face mental health challenges. Reaching out for help is a sign of strength, not weakness. These resources exist because you matter.
